items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: And they had a guy by the name of Napoleon, played tenor, from Santo Domingo.

ctx.x: There was another trumpet player in there called -- they used to call him Chico, a Puerto Rican trumpet player. And they had a guy by the name of Napoleon, played tenor, from Santo Domingo. Who -- he had a West Indian guitar
player named Lufu. He had another (unintelligible).
